ground_truth.matching: class-constrained maximum-cardinality minimum-cost one-to-one box-center distance

limitations: CVAT accuracy scores image-coordinate box centers on annotated processed frames only; they do not establish physical localization accuracy.
No temporal tracking, cue geometry, physics, or camera-to-client path is exercised.
The match tolerance associates corresponding outputs and is not a production acceptance threshold.
Inference timing is intentionally not reported by this equivalence tool.
Ground-truth radius is a configurable audit association threshold, not a production acceptance criterion. Center errors describe matched detections only; misses are counted separately.

expected_input_contract.resize_and_letterbox: Runtime adapter responsibility; must be verified against the reference preprocessing before equivalence is claimed.

output_contract.nms: not embedded; runtime decoding and thresholds are separate
output_contract.tensor_names_and_shapes: not captured; inspect the exported graph

scope: model detection output equivalence and annotated image-center accuracy; not physical accuracy or performance
